Source: https://github.com/nothings/stb `stb_truetype.h` at commit 6e9f34d (version 1.26), unmodified (SHA-256 `ecd30b05e0dd4fea3a13c26810dd9e1992dc379049482c393d5a19e6b5090aab`). License in LICENSE (MIT or public domain, your choice; the same text ends the header).
Use: the Android pause menu's text (`dm/android/overlay_font.c` includes it with `STBTT_STATIC` and `STB_TRUETYPE_IMPLEMENTATION`): the system's Roboto (`/system/fonts/RobotoStatic-Regular.ttf`, else `Roboto-Regular.ttf`), rasterized antialiased into a glyph cache. Without a font the menu keeps its 5x7 bitmap letters.
